responsibility: Defines the ISO mathematical function interface for LONGREAL values, including constants, square root, exponential/logarithmic, trigonometric, power, rounding, and exception-state query operations. It is the long-precision real-math specification consumed by gm2 programs and used alongside lower-level floating-point property modules.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for LongMath: it specifies the exported LONGREAL math constants and procedures, while LongMath.mod provides the concrete bindings to libm/compiler builtins that realize them.
